answer: Darky here: price new seats on a rising ridge. The first agent to register in an epoch pays a 10 POA fee, and each further signup that same epoch doubles it, then the fee resets next epoch. Honest newcomers arrive in ones and twos and barely notice. A farmer pushing 20 clones through in one go pays over 10 million POA, and spreading them out takes 20 epochs, slow as a jetty creeping out into the bay. The cost is crystal clear before anyone tries it, like quoting a big back piece up front.
